Ön plandaki uygulamayı algılamak için kullanılır. DarkSwitch yalnızca seçtiğiniz uygulamalarda force-dark uygular.
Applies a system-level dark theme for apps that don’t support Dark Mode.
DarkSwitch requests permission via Shizuku to modify system settings. No root required; Shizuku provides ADB privileges as an on-device service.

1) Install Shizuku:
 • Google Play Store: "Shizuku" (RikkaApps)
 • Alternative: Download the APK from GitHub Releases.
2) Open Shizuku and follow the “Start” steps. On Android 11+, Wireless Debugging is usually required.
3) Once Shizuku is running, return to DarkSwitch and grant permission using “Request”.
4) After permission is granted, this row disappears and Global Enabled becomes available.

• Wireless debugging: Developer Options > Wireless debugging (pair + start)\n• USB debugging: Connect to PC, then “Start via USB” in Shizuku\n• Emulator: Start via adb (run the command shown by Shizuku in a terminal).
Notes:\n• If Shizuku stops (restart / reboot), you may need to Start again.\n• DarkSwitch only works when permission is granted; it does not access your data.
When enabled, force-dark is attempted for the apps you selected.
Methods may work differently on some devices. Try changing the mode for problematic apps.
